title: Construct K Palindrome Strings
description: Check if s can construct k palindromes by counting characters with odd frequencies.
pseudocode:
1. If k > length(s), return false
2. Count frequency of each character
3. Calculate odd_count = number of characters with odd frequencies
4. If odd_count <= k, return true, else return false

steps.note: Check if k (2) is greater than length of s (9). It is not.
Count character frequencies: a:2, n:2, b:1, e:2, l:2
Calculate odd_count. Only 'b' has frequency 1. odd_count = 1.
Compare odd_count (1) with k (2). Since 1 <= 2, return true.
